operation.description:
MUTATING operation. Verify target and authorized intent; reconcile outcome before retry. Creates a requisition (a stock movement: inbound, outbound or transfer) together with its line items.

The body uses the nested-model convention: a `Requisition` object plus a `RequisitionItem` array. At least one line item is required for a meaningful requisition.

**Required:** `Requisition.store_id` (a valid, active warehouse). Each line item needs a `product_id` and a positive `quantity`.

**Success response** is `{ "status": true, "id": <new id> }` returned with HTTP `200`. Add the `extended` flag to also receive the saved record under `data`.

**Validation failures** return `{ "status": false, "message": ..., "errors": { ... } }` (also HTTP `200`). A line `quantity` of zero or less, or an `attachment` sent as an array instead of a comma-separated string, are rejected with HTTP `400`.

parameters.name: extended
parameters.description: When present, the success response also includes the saved record under `data`.

store_id.description: Source warehouse id. Required; must be a valid, active warehouse.

type.description:
Stock effect. Determines whether stock is added or deducted.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 1 | Inbound (adds stock) |
| 2 | Outbound (deducts stock) |
| 3 | Manual Transfer (no net effect) |

order_type.description:
Origin / nature of the requisition.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 1 | Manual Inbound |
| 2 | Manual Outbound |
| 3 | Invoice |
| 4 | Refund Receipt |
| 5 | Credit Note |
| 6 | Purchase Invoice |
| 7 | Purchase Refund |
| 8 | Manual Transfer |
| 11 | POS Inbound |
| 12 | POS Outbound |
| 13 | Stocktaking Out |
| 14 | Stocktaking In |
| 15 | Purchase Debit Note |
| 16 | Manufacturing Order Returned Materials |
| 18 | Manufacturing Order Materials Outbound |
| 21 | Manufacturing Order Scrap Inbound |
| 22 | Manufacturing Order Product Inbound |
| 23 | Manual Import Inbound |
| 24 | Manual Import Outbound |
| 25 | Sales Order |

to_store_id.description: Destination warehouse id (transfer requisitions only). If supplied, must be active and different from `store_id`.

date.description: Requisition date (account date format). Defaults to today when omitted. Must fall in an open accounting period.

currency_code.description: Currency code. Defaults to the account currency / source-document currency when omitted.

number.description: Requisition number. Generated automatically when omitted.

attachment.description: Comma-separated attachment file ids. Must be a string — sending an array is rejected with HTTP 400.

draft.description: Set to `1` to save as a draft; cost-center validation is skipped for drafts.

is_manufacturing_order.description: Set to `1` for manufacturing-order requisitions (triggers manufacturing-order handling).

is_stock_request.description: Set to `1` for stock-request requisitions (triggers stock-request handling).

work_order_id.description: Optional work order to link the requisition to.

RequisitionItem.description: Line items. At least one is required.

quantity.description: Quantity. Must be greater than zero.

unit_price.description: Unit price. Defaulted from the product / latest stock cost when omitted.

cost_center_id.description: Cost center id. Required per line when cost-center distribution is enabled and the requisition is not a draft.

200.description: Requisition created. Returns `{status:true, id}` (plus `data` when `extended` is sent). A validation failure returns `{status:false, message, errors}` with the same HTTP 200 status.

data.description: Only present when the `extended` flag is sent. Contains the saved requisition and its line items.

400.description: A line item has a quantity of zero or less, or `attachment` was sent as an array instead of a comma-separated string.

403.description: The authenticated user lacks permission to create requisitions.
